title: WMS Outgoing Orders Dashboard
description: A real-time warehouse management dashboard for tracking and managing outgoing orders. Features live updates across connected clients via Socket.io, full CRUD, and a status timeline showing each order's progression from picking to dispatch.

title: Letterboxd
description: A film reviewing app. It uses TMDB and OMDB's APIs to get the films' data so users can review, rate, like, make lists and keep a diary of their watched films.
